messages.content: We need to procure 300 laptops for our regional offices.

I can help structure this procurement need. This appears to be a goods procurement requirement. Before preparing the requirement, I need the delivery locations, quantity required at each location, required delivery period, available budget or budget source, minimum technical requirements, warranty requirements, and any required after-sales support.
We need a consulting firm to design an enterprise architecture for our organization.

This appears to be a consultancy services requirement. To structure the procurement need, I need the objectives of the assignment, expected scope of work, required deliverables, assignment duration, required expertise or key personnel, reporting requirements, available budget, and expected evaluation approach.
We need a company to clean our offices for one year.

This appears to be a non-consultancy services requirement. To structure the requirement, I need the locations to be covered, approximate floor area or facility size, required cleaning frequency, service hours, required staffing levels if known, consumables and equipment responsibilities, service-level expectations, contract duration, and available budget.
We need to construct a new warehouse.

This appears to be a works procurement requirement. Before preparing the requirement, I need the project location, intended warehouse capacity and use, available designs or technical studies, expected scope of works, target completion period, estimated budget, funding source, site availability, required permits, and any known technical or environmental requirements.
Which procurement method should I use for goods worth 8 million ETB?

The procurement method should not be determined from the amount alone. I need to retrieve the currently applicable procurement rules and thresholds and consider the procuring entity, funding source, procurement category, applicable jurisdiction, and any permitted exceptions before recommending a procurement method.
Prepare a purchase requirement for 50 printers.

I can prepare the requirement, but important information is still missing. Please provide the printer type and intended use, quantity by delivery location, minimum technical requirements, connectivity requirements, expected monthly workload, warranty requirements, delivery period, budget information, and whether consumables or maintenance should be included.
